name: Von ven soup
summary: Soup of lá vón vén and scorched buffalo tail. Báo Sơn La, on 2 July 2021, simmers the tail and calls the bowl plain, lightly sour, and sweet in the broth. It is the bowl after a long round of rượu, at home and on Thái restaurant tables. A leaf quantity was not printed.
taste: Báo Sơn La says lightly sour and sweet in the broth.
howToEat: As the soup, with the meal. An hour and a price are Check on arrival.
where: The Thái table. A street was not named.
seoTitle: Canh von ven in Son La — leaf soup with buffalo tail
seoDescription: Canh lá vón vén in Sơn La. Báo Sơn La simmers scorched buffalo tail and calls the broth lightly sour and sweet. A price is Check on arrival.
